verdict.rationale: The Torch developer portal documents a sandbox for the machine channel. Developers register an account and join a team (uscis-docs-4), then gain access and develop in the Sandbox environment to send test data (uscis-docs-5). They pass a demo before receiving production keys (uscis-docs-6), and the sandbox covers the Case Status and FOIA APIs (uscis-supp-1, uscis-supp-2). That is a clear test-before-production path, though it is gated by registration and described only in brief portal lines. Missing for 10: detailed sandbox documentation (test data sets, endpoint parity with production, sandbox limits) and independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox works end to end.
